bugClass: parser: naive split ignores quoted delimiters → silent data corruption + missing error path
oneLineBug: parseCsvLine returns line.split(',') — quoted commas wrongly split, quotes are left in values, "" is not decoded, and an unterminated quote never throws
groundTruthProbe: parseCsvLine('"a,b",c') must be ['a,b','c'] (2 fields); buggy returns ['"a','b"','c'] (3 fields). parseCsvLine('"x') must throw; buggy returns ['"x'].
notesForScoringOnly: Tests the fuzz/adversarial + error-path lenses. A happy-path test on unquoted input ('a,b,c') PASSES on the buggy impl, so only quoted-comma and unterminated-quote stimulus catches it. Strong candidate for the conservation/round-trip invariant ('quoted commas are data') and a malformed-input fuzz check.
